title: Tomato & basil pasta
description: A bright, simple supper with sweet tomatoes, basil and a little Parmesan.
personalNote: Demonstration recipe — replace this with one of your own favourites.
importantNotes: Use pasta with an 8–10 minute packet cooking time. Longer-cooking pasta will increase the total time.

steps.title: Get everything ready
steps.description: Fill a large saucepan with water and bring it to the boil. While it heats, halve the tomatoes, slice the garlic and grate the cheese.
steps.tip: Read the pasta packet now so you know its exact cooking time.

steps.title: Start the pasta
steps.description: Add a pinch of salt and the spaghetti to the boiling water. Stir once to separate the strands. Cook for the time on the packet. This demo uses 10 minutes.
steps.warning: The timer is a reminder. The packet time takes priority.

steps.title: Make the sauce alongside it
steps.description: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes and cook for 7 minutes, stirring every minute or so. Press a few tomatoes gently with the spoon to release their juice.
steps.doneness: Tomatoes soft, with a little juice in the pan. Garlic pale golden, not dark brown.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.description: Before draining, scoop out a small mug of pasta water. Drain the spaghetti carefully. Add it to the tomatoes with a splash of pasta water and toss for 1–2 minutes. Add the basil, taste, and adjust the salt. Serve with the cheese.
steps.doneness: A glossy sauce lightly coating the pasta.
steps.tip: Add pasta water a tablespoon at a time; you may not need the whole mug.
steps.warning: Steam and boiling water are hot — drain away from your face.

timeline.task: Boil water and prepare tomatoes, garlic and cheese
Cook pasta to the packet instructions
timeline.parallel: While the pasta cooks, make the sauce.

substitutions.title: No spaghetti?
substitutions.text: Use another dried pasta; follow its packet time.

substitutions.title: No cheese?
substitutions.text: Leave it out. The tomatoes and basil still make a lovely sauce.

troubleshooting.title: Sauce looks dry
troubleshooting.text: Stir in another tablespoon of reserved pasta water.
